completion:
Establish the key dates of the building’s construction – particularly its building-approval date.

**For each contravention of the Building Code issued:**

3. Draw up a list of the items that have failed to meet the requirements of the Building Code (noting the specific clause of the Building Code, and providing enough detail in the narrative to identify where the contravention took place); also identify the exact building system that has failed. Ensure that each item/object is linked to the room in the building where the problem occurs – even though not every hyperlink is required (refer to Appendix 1 – templates).
4. Confirm whether the identified problem has actually caused a fail in the Real Time [Fire Safety] Checks survey recently performed. If possible, specifically identify when the problem occurred – for instance, did the identified contravention persist for the whole duration of the period being inspected?
5. Identify the provisions of the Building Act 20
